summary: The Brittle Star's fire and cord-slice sounds are now rate-limited per hull (new BrittleStarConfigSO fields fireSoundMinSeconds 0.08 s, cordSliceSoundMinSeconds 0.05 s); gameplay unchanged.
why: Unthrottled, three AI Brittle Stars left ~7,500 FMOD instances alive and FMOD's command queue stalled Brittle Star Time I4 for 14-180 s at a time. Compiled in Unity, not race-tested yet.
